title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Lead Times, Delay Thresholds and Delay Credit Limits by Program
content:
The quoted lead time, the vendor delay threshold and the delay remedy figures differ across the six Ridgeline Special Order Services programs, as does whether a vendor may ship an order in parts.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Quoted lead time** — calendar days from the order date to the promised ready date quoted at order.
- **Vendor delay threshold** — calendar days by which the estimated ready date may pass the promised ready date before the delay remedies apply.
- **Delay cancellation in production** — whether the delay remedy allows a fee-free cancellation even after production has started.
- **Delay credit percentage** — the credit offered, as a percentage of the order total, to a customer who keeps a delayed order instead of cancelling.
- **Delay credit maximum** — the largest delay credit per order, in US dollars.
- **Partial shipment** — whether the vendor may ship part of the order ahead of the rest.

## Schedule

| Program | Quoted lead time (days) | Vendor delay threshold (days) | Delay credit percentage | Delay credit maximum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 10 | 14 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 14 | 10 | 5 | 100.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 21 | 10 | 5 | 100.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 42 | 21 | 5 | 250.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 56 | 21 | 5 | 500.00 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 21 | 14 | 5 | 250.00 |

| Program | Delay cancellation in production | Partial shipment |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | no | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | yes | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | no | no |

## Reading the schedule

- Catalog Merchandise has a delay credit percentage of 0 and a maximum of 0.00: the program offers no delay credit.
- A hypothetical Semi-Custom Cabinetry order placed on 1 March carries a promised ready date 56 calendar days later, 26 April; the delay threshold of 21 days is passed only by an estimated ready date later than 17 May.
- Cut-to-Order Flooring and Fabricated Countertops do not allow a delay cancellation once production has started.
